svg.aria-label: The full mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist, unless you skip it (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner (agent); Literature strategist: the sections with no source (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Outline approval (stop); Draft writer (agent); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the model list gave none (agent, only when needed); Visualization, with data (agent, only when needed); Citation compliance (agent); Citation compliance once more, when a check fails (agent, only when needed); A claim the run cannot support, or a reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the entries fail the same check (stop); Peer reviewer (agent); Draft writer: a patch (agent); The draft review does not pass (stop); Draft writer: reference fix (agent, only when needed); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); /writing: 4 agents (agent); End: the report; your reply, optional (agent); Draft writer: applies what you pick (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, for a double-blind venue (agent, only when needed).
